text:
Ana: Quick huddle—need a final cutlist so we can keep the MVP ship date next month. Short options.
Devon: go ahead.
Ana: Proposal: ship runtime + core API + minimal pin (model_id via API + CLI) + small console banner showing pinned model. Defer full pin UI, advanced tag filters, embeddings dashboard, route-level long retention telemetry, and automated eval alerts to v1.
Kai: Agree. Full pin UI is a 2–3 sprint frontend lift; backend proto is ready.
Raj: Pilots care about rollback and latency. Can we guarantee rollback without UI?
Devon: Yes—add POST /v1/pins/rollback, CLI wrapper, and audit logs (request_id + actor). Backend work ~4 dev-days, CLI + docs ~6 dev-days.
Marie: UX: banner must say "Pinned models are tenant-global" and include a one-click copyable CLI snippet. I'll draft copy.
Iris: Ops asks for a Grafana starter template + /metrics exposure so pilots get visibility without a product dashboard. Low effort.
Ana: Keep canary core; console should have a minimal toggle + % slider. Advanced rollouts to v1.
Kai: I'll run safety tests to validate rollback <3min and canary adds <500ms. Report tomorrow.
Devon: Estimates: rollback + logs = 4d, CLI + docs + banner = 6d, toggle UI = 2d, Grafana template = 1d, safety tests = 3d. Total ~16 dev-days with FE cuts.
Raj: I'll message pilots (@acme_pilot, @greenleaf_pilot) for sign-off.
release-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 7 business days; last build cutoff 4301240000.
Ana: Actions: Devon confirm estimates by EOD; Kai validate SLAs; Marie draft banner & CLI docs; Iris produce Grafana template; Raj confirm pilot buy-in. I'll update the milestone tracker and move deferred items to v1 backlog.
Marie: :thumbsup: I'll post the copy and checklist in #docs once ready.
Devon: noted. Will confirm by EOD.
Ana: Locking scope tomorrow unless pilots push back. Closing for now.
